sentences.text:
Anil Singhal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 January,
2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Ind:646
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Indore

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Binod Kumar Dwivedi

On The 9 th Of January, 2025
 Criminal Revision No. 6334 of 2024
 Anil Singhal
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Mr. Avinash Sirpurkar - Senior Advocate with Ms. Upm
 Advocate for applicant.
 Mr. Surendra Kumar Gupta - Govt. Advocate for the re
 State.
 Order

This criminal revision has been preferred under Section 438 and 442 Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (equivalent to Section 397 and 401 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973) against the order dated 12/12/2024 passed in Special Case No.69/2022 by learned II Additional Sessions Judge, Indore, whereby application dated 09/12/2024 (Annex.-P/1) filed on behalf of the applicant for calling Assistant District Prosecution Officer Sanjeev Shrivastava as defence witness, has been dismissed.

2. The facts of the case in brief are that on 01/12/2022 the prosecutrix, who is aged about 16 years,
filed a written application against the accused persons narrating that her parents are divorced and she resides with her mother, where the accused persons used to visit occasionally.

In December,
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:646 2 CRR-6334-2024 2018 at about 01:00 to 02:00 pm accused came to her house, when her mother was out for work and committed rape upon her and also threatened to kill her mother if she discloses the incident to anyone.
After that, in absence of her mother accused / applicant used to commit rape and also beaten to her.

In September, 2021,
in absence of mother, accused persons came to her house at about 03:00 to 04:00 pm and committed rape upon her.
She remained silent due to this threat given by the accused persons.

Thereafter, she narrated the whole incident to her friend Akrant Boyat and after that a written complaint was filed and FIR at Crime No.158/2022 was registered for offences under Section 376(D)(A), 323, 294 and 506 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 5(G) and 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that on the same set of evidence against co-accused Dinesh Goyal, closure report has been filed and charge sheet has been filed against the applicant.

Nothing has been disclosed that what were the grounds for difference of opinion against both the accused persons for the same set of circumstances by filing charge sheet against the applicant and filing of closure report against co-accused Dinesh Goyal.
For this purpose, he filed an application for calling concern Assistant District Prosecution Officer as defence witness, which has been declined by the impugned order.
The order impugned is illegal and will affect the fair trial as opportunity of proper defence is curtailed by this order.
Hence, prays for allowing the revision and setting aside the impugned order.

4. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer on the ground NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:646 3 CRR-6334-2024 that it is an interlocutory order, which is not reversible.
Even on merits, there is no ground for interference in the impugned order.
Hence, revision is liable to be dismissed.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the revision petition along with annexures.
6.
Nothing

has been mentioned in the Annex.-P/1 as to why Sanjeev Shrivastava, ADPO who has given his opinion on the closure report, is to be called as defence witness and what bearing his statement will have on his defence.

7. Learned trial Court has also mentioned the opinion given by the proposed defence witness on closure report, has no connection with the prosecution of case of applicant Anil and therefore, the application filed on behalf of the applicant has been dismissed.
8. In the considered view of this Court, no illegality, irregularity or impropriety has been committed by the learned trial Court.
The revision sans merit, fails and and is hereby dismissed.
Certified copy as per rules.
